type Item = { value?: string } & { value: string | undefined };
const item: Item = { value: undefined };
console.log(item.value.toUpperCase());

class Data {
  get value(): string | undefined { return undefined; }
  set value(value: string | number | undefined) { console.log(value); }
}
const data: Data & { value?: string } = new Data();
data.value = 1;
